encoder_method_note:
The message is encoded in the heights of the ten skyline buildings, which all share the same width so that height is the only varying attribute. Each building's height is 10 times the alphabetical index of a letter (a=1 … z=26): 30,120,10,180,10 gives c,l,a,r,a and 220,10,140,30,50 gives v,a,n,c,e. The space between the words is represented by the wider gap containing the small tree (a "park") that separates the two groups of five buildings.
